summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Leggimi (Italian accessible reader). 22/22 pytest cases pass covering auth (register, login, /me, logout, invalid Google session), book CRUD (upload, list, content, delete, search), and ownership isolation between users. Frontend UI verified end-to-end via Playwright at mobile viewport 390x844: splash + auto-redirect, register-then-home, home upload CTA & empty state, offcanvas drawer with all 4 links + logout, search modal, bottom tab navigation (Home / Libreria / Profilo / Impostazioni), library screen, profile card with provider badge, settings TTS sliders/presets, PDF upload via web file chooser followed by book row -> reader screen with Play/Prev/Next controls and page counter, logout via profile, wrong-password login shows localized error, book persistence across logout+login. All flows working with no crashes/red-screens.

issues: Slide animation on Expo web starts the drawer at y=viewportHeight and animates to y=0; automated testing has to wait ~1s for the animation to finish before drawer items are click-actionable. No user-visible defect once animation completes (drawer is rendered fullscreen 82% width, aligned left as intended).

action_items: No functional fixes required. Optional polish: consider disabling the Modal slide animation on web (animationType="none" when Platform.OS === 'web') so the drawer appears instantly for keyboard/AT users; current slide is smooth on native but adds a ~300ms delay on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id from all responses via projection; owner_id scoping on every books query prevents cross-user access (verified with dedicated ownership tests).
Passwords hashed with bcrypt (bcrypt.hashpw + gensalt); session tokens are random UUIDs stored in Mongo with 7-day TTL index (expireAfterSeconds=0) — good.

Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exclusively (no hardcoded URLs). Every interactive element has a testID. Text is always wrapped in <Text>. Touch targets are ≥44px (chip=52, buttons ≥48-96).
seed_data_creation: Two fresh TEST_ prefixed users are created per pytest session (session-scope fixtures); PDFs uploaded during tests are named TEST_*.pdf. The pre-seeded test@leggimi.it / testpass123 user was also exercised via the login UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_leggimi_api.py — run from /app/backend (pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope; keep classes/modules self-contained). BASE_URL is read from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Playwright on web preview: use viewport 390x844, all elements have testID, drawer needs ~1s wait after menu-button click due to slide-in animation on Expo web; use JS click or wait_for_timeout(1200) before clicking drawer-link-* items.
